fullTextEN: Hello, I am Xika from Taiwan.
How are you?

fullTextZH: 今天我要告诉你的故事叫《自相矛盾》。
fullTextEN: Today I want to tell you a story called 'Self-Contradiction'.
'Self-Contradiction' is a Chinese idiom.

fullTextZH: 成语这四个字不是很重要，
fullTextEN: The four characters of the idiom are not very important,
but this story is very interesting.
You can listen and see.

fullTextZH: 现在来看我画图说故事吧。
fullTextEN: Now let's watch me draw and tell the story.
There are many people in the market.

fullTextZH: 这个商人想让大家看他来买他的东西。
fullTextEN: This merchant wants everyone to see him and buy his things.
So he wants to tell everyone,
his spear and shield are very good.
He holds the spear and says, 'Hey,
please take a look,
my spear is the best spear,
it is very powerful,

fullTextZH: 它可以刺穿所有的东西，
fullTextEN: it can pierce through everything,

fullTextZH: 木头、石头、人都可以刺穿。”
fullTextEN: wood, stone, and people can all be pierced.'

fullTextZH: 很多人听到他说的话都过来了。
fullTextEN: Many people came over after hearing what he said.
They want to see the merchant's spear.
The merchant saw so many people coming,
He was very happy.
Then he took the shield,
He said, "Hey,
Please take a look at my shield.
My shield is the best shield,
It is extremely hard,

fullTextZH: 没有东西可以打破这个盾，
fullTextEN: Nothing can break this shield,
You cannot break this shield,
It is the best shield."

fullTextZH: 这个时候有一个人问商人：
fullTextEN: At this time, a person asked the merchant:
"Your shield is the best shield,
It cannot be broken;
Your spear is the best spear,
It can pierce through everything.

fullTextZH: 那如果用你的矛刺你的盾会怎么样呢？”
fullTextEN: So what would happen if you used your spear to pierce your shield?"
The merchant listened,
He didn't know what to say.

fullTextZH: 如果他拿矛刺盾，刺不破，
fullTextEN: If he used the spear to pierce the shield and it didn't break,

fullTextZH: 那他的矛就不是最好的矛，
fullTextEN: Then his spear would not be the best spear,
The words he said are different;
If the spear pierces the shield,

fullTextZH: 那他的盾就不是最好的盾，
fullTextEN: Then his shield is not the best shield,
The words he said are different.

fullTextZH: 现在他发现他说的话很奇怪，
fullTextEN: Now he finds his words very strange,
He feels very embarrassed,
So he ran away.

fullTextZH: 这就是自相矛盾的故事。
fullTextEN: This is the story of self-contradiction.

fullTextZH: 现在我们看看这四个字：
fullTextEN: Now let's look at these four characters:
Self-contradiction.

fullTextZH: 你知道矛和盾是什么意思？
fullTextEN: Do you know what spear and shield mean?
Chinese characters are very cute,

fullTextZH: 矛这个字看起来像一只矛。
fullTextEN: The character for spear looks like a spear.

fullTextZH: 盾这个字看起来像一个盾。
fullTextEN: The character for shield looks like a shield.

fullTextZH: 自相就是自己和自己的意思，
fullTextEN: Self-contradiction means oneself and oneself,
So,

fullTextZH: 自相矛盾就是用自己的矛刺自己的盾。
fullTextEN: Self-contradiction is using one's own spear to pierce one's own shield.

fullTextZH: 如果有人像故事里的商人，
fullTextEN: If someone is like the merchant in the story,

fullTextZH: 前面说的话和后面说的话不一样，
fullTextEN: The words said before and after are different,
Making you feel very strange,
What you said, which is true?
What is correct?
This is a contradiction.

fullTextZH: 那我们不常常说自相矛盾这四个字，
fullTextEN: So we don't often say the four words 'contradiction',

fullTextZH: 我们常常说矛盾两个字，
fullTextEN: We often say the two words 'contradiction',
The meaning is the same.
For example, I tell you:
"This cookie is very healthy,
it's very good for your body,
and it also tastes good,
because it has a lot of sugar,
very sweet, you will definitely like it."
Hmm,
A lot of sugar is healthy?
This is very contradictory, right?
Now you can think,

fullTextZH: 你听过或看过矛盾的事吗？
fullTextEN: Have you heard or seen contradictory things?

fullTextZH: 或是你做过或说过矛盾的事吗？
fullTextEN: Or have you done or said contradictory things?
Please leave a comment and share with me.

fullTextZH: 我希望你喜欢今天的影片，
fullTextEN: I hope you like today's video,
See you next time, bye.
